title: Belmar Manutti Marina

services.name: Charter Boats:
services.desc: Belmar Marina is also the home of New Jersey’s largest party and charter boat fleet. The boats are privately owned and their prices are at the discretion of the owners. The prices vary depending on the length of time and the type of fishing. They offer special rates to groups, children and senior citizens. Food, drinks and rental rods are available on the boats. They sail 365 days a year as long as there are customers. With over 50 years experience fishing the Raritan Bay, Sandy Hook and the New Jersey coastal waters, the Celtic Stoirm’s dedicated crew is waiting to provide you with a fishing experience you won’t soon forget. services.desc: The Friends of the Belmar Harbor is a volunteer-driven nonprofit educational organization which promotes the health and vitality of the Shark River Bay, especially to youth and families of limited means, abilities or opportunities. Adventures in competitive and recreational sailing, kayaking, ecosystem tours, shoreline cleanups and related activities that are accessible, affordable and fun. Hours are subject to change.
